{{Top|leg}}
'''Spymaster''' was the term used to describe high ranking members of the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]], typically those experienced individuals who ran their own operations. [[Koth Melan]] was considered to be a spymaster. In more of a general sense, the term spymaster was applied to [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and other intelligence operatives who controlled networks of their own operatives, often on a galactic scale. [[Keeper (Imperial Intelligence)|Keeper]], [[Szajin]], and [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] were all considered spymasters.
